title: MIMIC: Multimodal Islamophobic Meme Identification and Classification
findings: The proposed model, based on the Vision-and-Language Transformer (ViLT), effectively detects anti-Muslim hate speech in memes, outperforming other models like VisualBERT and CLIP. It achieved a strong F1-weighted score of 0.738 with 10-fold cross-validation, demonstrating good generalization. However, a standard train-test split resulted in a lower score (0.581) due to overfitting, highlighting the challenges of classifying subtle and complex visual hate content with a small dataset.
